text.tspan: Pay the full ₱13,000.00 before pickup. The first ₱8,000.00 goes to the deposit. GCash is simulated in this prototype; a cashier verifies each payment.

Read the contract and sign it here before pickup, or sign the printed copy the owner brings. The vehicle can only be released once it is signed.
